info.name: Order Processing System API
info.description:
API collection for Auth, Orders, and Payments with JWT authentication.

Setup:
1. Set `base_url` (default: http://127.0.0.1:8000/api)
2. Run Register or Login — token is saved automatically
3. Create a confirmed order before processing payments

request.description: Register a new user. dont worry your JWT token will be saved automaticlly on success (201).
